meals.title: Breakfast Burritos
meals.description: Make-ahead egg, sausage, and cheese burritos built for the freezer.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 6 large flour tortillas
- 10 eggs, beaten
- 1 lb breakfast sausage
- 1 cup shredded cheddar
- 1 diced bell pepper
- 1/2 diced onion
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Hot sauce or salsa, optional

## Instructions
1. Brown the sausage in a skillet, breaking it up. Remove and set aside.
2. Soften the onion and pepper in the sausage fat, ~4 minutes.
3. Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble softly. Fold the sausage back in.
4. Warm the tortillas so they roll without cracking.
5. Fill each with eggs, sausage, and cheese. Fold in the sides and roll tight.
6. Serve now, or wrap individually in foil and freeze.

## Notes
To reheat from frozen: unwrap, microwave 2–2.5 minutes, flipping halfway.

## Tips
- Let the filling cool before rolling if you're freezing — less sogginess.
- A thin layer of cheese against the tortilla acts like glue.

## Variations
- Swap sausage for chorizo, bacon, or black beans (vegetarian).
- Add cooked hash-brown shreds for a heartier burrito.

meals.title: Chicken Alfredo
meals.description: Creamy homemade fettuccine alfredo with seared chicken.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 8 oz fettuccine
- 2 tbsp butter
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 1 cup grated parmesan
- Salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning to taste
- Fresh parsley for garnish

## Instructions
1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
2. Sear in a hot pan with a little oil, ~5–6 minutes per side, until 165°F. Rest, then slice.
3. Cook the fettuccine in salted water until al dente. Reserve **1/2 cup pasta water** before draining.
4. In the same pan, melt butter and cook the garlic 30 seconds until fragrant.
5. Add cream, bring to a gentle simmer, then whisk in the parmesan until smooth.
6. Loosen the sauce with pasta water as needed, toss in the pasta, and top with sliced chicken.

## Notes
Grate the parmesan fresh — pre-shredded cheese has anti-caking agents that make the sauce grainy.

## Tips
- Don't let the cream boil hard or it can split.
- Add a pinch of nutmeg for a classic alfredo depth.

## Variations
- Swap chicken for shrimp (cook just 2–3 minutes).
- Stir in steamed broccoli or peas for a one-bowl meal.

meals.title: Chicken Pot Pie
meals.description: Easy Bisquick chicken pot pie with mixed veggies and a golden crust.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 bag frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
- 1 cup cut-up cooked chicken
- 1 can (10.75 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup
- 1 cup Original Bisquick mix
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 egg

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F.
2. In an ungreased 9-inch glass pie plate, stir together the vegetables, chicken, and soup.
3. In a small bowl, stir the Bisquick, milk, and egg with a fork until blended. Pour over the chicken mixture.
4. Bake about 30 minutes, until golden brown.

## Notes
The original card's directions were accidentally copied from the enchilada recipe, so these steps follow the classic Bisquick pot pie method that matches its ingredients.

meals.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
meals.description: Classic chewy chocolate chip cookies with dark brown sugar, baked low and slow.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 2 sticks butter, softened to room temperature
- 1 cup dark brown sugar
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla
- 3 cups flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 cups chocolate chips

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 300°F.
2. With a mixer, beat the butter, dark brown sugar, and granulated sugar until well mixed.
3. Mix in the eggs and vanilla.
4. Add the flour, baking soda, and salt and mix.
5. Stir in the chocolate chips.
6. Bake about 15 minutes, until the cookies are light brown.
7. Let them sit on the cookie sheet a few extra minutes before moving them to a cooling rack.

## Tips
- Cookies turn out better if each batch goes onto a somewhat cool cookie sheet.

meals.title: Grandma's Chili
meals.description: Simple, hearty beef and bean chili that's ready fast or happy to simmer.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb ground beef or ground turkey
- 1 can black beans (or kidney beans)
- 1 can diced tomatoes
- 1 can tomato sauce
- 1–2 tbsp dehydrated onions (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste

## Instructions
1. Cook the beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned.
2. Add the remaining ingredients and heat until bubbling.
3. Serve right away, or cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for up to 1 hour.

## Tips
- Serve in bowls, on baked potatoes, on a bed of lettuce, or over tortilla chips.
- Top with cheese, sour cream, lettuce, tomato, and more.

meals.title: Ground Beef Enchiladas
meals.description: Seasoned beef and salsa rolled in corn tortillas and baked in enchilada sauce.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1/2 onion, chopped
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp pepper
- 1 cup salsa
- 1 tbsp chili powder
- 1 tsp paprika
- 1 tsp cumin
- 2 cans (10 oz) enchilada sauce (red or green)
- Corn tortillas
- Shredded cheese

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
2. In a large skillet, brown the ground beef with the onion. Season with salt, pepper, chili powder, paprika, and cumin. Stir in the salsa.
3. Simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes so the flavors combine.
4. Pour a little enchilada sauce over the bottom of a 9x13 baking pan.
5. Warm the rest of the sauce in a saucepan, then dip each tortilla in it.
6. Spoon meat mixture into each tortilla, roll it up, and place seam-side down in the pan. Repeat until the meat is gone.
7. Pour the remaining sauce over the enchiladas and top with cheese.
8. Bake for 10 minutes, until heated through.

meals.title: Ground Beef Tacos
meals.description: Weeknight beef tacos with a quick homemade seasoning blend.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb ground beef
- 8 taco shells or small tortillas
- 1 tbsp chili powder
- 1 tsp cumin
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- 1/2 tsp paprika
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 cup water
- Toppings: lettuce, tomato, cheese, sour cream, salsa

## Instructions
1. Brown the ground beef over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles. Drain excess fat.
2. Stir in chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, and salt.
3. Add the water and simmer 3–4 minutes until it thickens into a glaze.
4. Warm the shells while the beef finishes.
5. Fill shells with beef and pile on toppings.

## Notes
The splash of water is the trick — it lets the spices bloom and coat the meat evenly.

## Tips
- Toast dry taco shells in a 350°F oven for 3 minutes for extra crunch.
- Double the seasoning batch and jar it for next time.

## Variations
- Use ground turkey or plant-based crumbles.
- Turn leftovers into a taco salad or quesadilla.

meals.title: Instant Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta
meals.description: Chicken, mushrooms, and pasta pressure-cooked in one pot with a cream cheese sauce.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 2 tbsp oil
- 2 tsp minced garlic
- 8 oz mushrooms
- 2 chicken breasts, cut into 1/2" pieces
- 1 can chicken stock
- 1 cup milk, half & half, or cream
- 1 lb pasta
- 8 oz cream cheese
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Parmesan cheese, for serving

## Instructions
1. Turn the Instant Pot to the **Sauté** setting.
2. Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, then add the mushrooms. Cook about 3 minutes, stirring now and then.
3. Add the chicken, broth, milk, and pasta. Stir.
4. Push **Cancel**.
5. Close and lock the lid, push **Pressure Cook**, and cook on high for 7 minutes.
6. Release the pressure and remove the lid.
7. Stir in the cream cheese.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve with parmesan.

meals.title: Lasagna
meals.description: Easy no-boil beef lasagna with spaghetti sauce, cottage cheese, and mozzarella.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb ground beef
- 3 cups spaghetti sauce
- 6 dry lasagna noodles (no need to boil)
- Cottage cheese
- 2 cups mozzarella cheese
- 1/4 cup water

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F.
2. Brown the beef and drain the grease. Stir in the spaghetti sauce.
3. In a rectangular dish, layer noodles, beef and sauce, then cheese. Make two layers, ending with cheese on top.
4. Slowly pour the water around the edge of the dish.
5. Cover and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 more minutes.
6. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

## Notes
The water cooks the dry noodles right in the oven, so there's no boiling step.

meals.title: Lemon Cake Mix Cookies
meals.description: Soft, crinkly lemon cookies made with just 5 simple ingredients.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 box (15.25 oz) lemon cake mix
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 2 large eggs
- 1 lemon, zested and juiced
- 1/4 cup powdered sugar

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
2. Combine the cake mix, oil, and eggs in a large bowl. Add **1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice** and **1 tablespoon lemon zest**.
3. Stir together just until combined. If you have time, refrigerate the dough for 15–20 minutes (it's sticky, and chilling makes it easier to work with).
4. Use a medium scoop or spoon to portion the dough, roll each ball in the powdered sugar, and place on the prepared baking sheet.
5. Bake 9–11 minutes, until the cookies are set. You don't want them to brown.
6. Cool on the pan for a couple of minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack.

## Notes
Bursting with fresh lemon flavor, and they look great in a holiday cookie box.

## Tips
- **To freeze:** Let the cookies cool, then freeze on a cookie sheet for 30 minutes. Once hard, stack in a freezer container or zip-top bag for up to 3 months. Take them out of the freezer 2 hours before serving.

meals.title: Oatmeal Cookies
meals.description: A big-batch, old-fashioned cinnamon oatmeal cookie made with buttermilk.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 4 cups brown sugar
- 2 cups butter, softened
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 2 tsp vanilla
- 4 cups flour
- 2 tsp salt
- 2 tsp baking soda
- 4 heaping tsp cinnamon
- 8 cups old-fashioned oats

## Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F.
2. Cream the butter and brown sugar together until smooth, then mix in the buttermilk and vanilla.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the flour, salt, baking soda, and cinnamon. Add to the wet mixture and stir until combined.
4. Stir in the oats.
5. Drop rounded spoonfuls onto a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.

## Notes
The original family recipe card lists only the ingredients and "Bake at 375 for 10 minutes." The mixing steps above are the standard method for this kind of cookie.

## Tips
- This makes a *lot* of cookies. Halve everything for a normal-sized batch.

meals.title: Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
meals.description: No-cook, make-ahead oats with peanut butter and banana.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 cup rolled oats
- 1 cup milk of choice
- 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt
- 2 tbsp peanut butter
- 1 tbsp maple syrup or honey
- 1/2 tsp vanilla
- 1 banana, sliced

## Instructions
1. Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, peanut butter, syrup, and vanilla together in a jar.
2. Fold in half the banana slices.
3. Seal and refrigerate **overnight** (at least 4 hours).
4. In the morning, top with the remaining banana and eat cold.

## Notes
Divide between two jars before chilling for grab-and-go portions.

## Tips
- Too thick? Splash in more milk. Too thin? Add a spoon of oats.
- Warm it 60 seconds in the microwave if you prefer it hot.

## Variations
- Swap peanut butter for almond butter and banana for berries.
- Add chia seeds for extra thickness and omega-3s.

meals.title: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
meals.description: Sticky teriyaki chicken over rice with steamed veggies — great for meal prep.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1.5 lb boneless chicken thighs, cubed
- 2 cups cooked white or brown rice
- 2 cups broccoli florets
- 1/3 cup soy sauce
- 3 tbsp honey
- 2 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tbsp grated ginger
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (slurry)
- Sesame seeds and green onion to garnish

## Instructions
1. Whisk soy sauce, honey, vinegar, ginger, and garlic to make the teriyaki sauce.
2. Sear the chicken in a hot pan until browned and cooked through, ~8–10 minutes.
3. Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes.
4. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook 1 minute until glossy and thick.
5. Steam the broccoli until crisp-tender.
6. Build bowls: rice, chicken, broccoli. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

## Notes
Thighs stay juicier than breasts for meal prep, but either works.

## Tips
- Portion into 4 containers; keeps 4 days in the fridge.
- Keep sauce slightly loose — it thickens as it cools.

## Variations
- Add edamame, carrots, or snap peas.
- Swap chicken for tofu or salmon.

meals.title: Tortellini Soup
meals.description: Hearty Italian sausage and tortellini soup with zucchini and tomatoes.
meals.body:
## Ingredients
- 1 lb Italian sausage (mild or spicy)
- 1/8 onion, chopped
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp dried basil
- 1 tbsp dried parsley
- 2 cloves garlic (or 2 tsp garlic salt or garlic powder)
- 1/2 cup carrots, sliced and cooked (unless you're simmering a long time, then they'll cook in the soup)
- 1 zucchini, grated
- 1 can (14–15 oz) diced tomatoes (petite diced preferred, regular is fine)
- 1 small can (8 oz) tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup apple juice
- 1/2 cup water
- 4 cans (14–15 oz each, about 60 oz total) chicken broth
- 1 lb tortellini (frozen, fresh, or dried)

## Instructions
1. Brown the sausage in a large soup pot with the onion and spices.
2. While it browns, slice and cook the carrots and grate the zucchini.
3. Once the sausage is browned, add everything else to the pot and heat through.
4. Serve, or keep it on a simmer (or in a crock pot) for hours. If simmering a while, make sure the carrots and any dried tortellini are soft before serving.

## Notes
With frozen or fresh tortellini and pre-cooked carrots, this soup is done in about 20 minutes.

## Tips
- Using dried tortellini? Let it simmer a long time, or cook it before adding.

## Variations
- Add or swap veggies however you like.
- Add extra water or broth if you want it brothier.
